source: Player aid 'Terrain Effects Chart' (transcribed by dev in assets/scans/terrain charts.md). Typos fixed. MP costs: normal / lightMud; Heavy Mud turns (GT 7-13) have no normal movement (18.34).

marsh.effects: Combat strength of Mech units defending in, or attacking into or from is halved, rounded down.

road.effects: Use road cost instead of hex cost when entering via road hexside. Cost for German Mech units conducting strategic movement is 1/2MP. Use other terrain in hex for combat effects.

town.effects: Defenders can't be flanked. Defender hits reduced by one. Improved Positions not allowed.

city.effects: Defenders can't be flanked. Defender hits reduced by one. Improved Positions not allowed.

village.note: Not on the chart: no terrain effect, use the other terrain in the hex (dev, 2026-10-08).

minorRiver.effects: Cost is to cross hexside. Use cost after slash in light mud game turns.

donets.effects: Cost is to cross hexside. Use cost after slash in light mud game turns. If all units attack across Donets hexsides, defender hits are reduced by one.

dniepr.effects: Entire Movement Allowance. Strength of units attacking across Dniepr hexside is halved (rounded down). If all units attack across Dniepr hexsides, reduce defender hits by one.
dniepr.note: Crossing is only possible for a unit that has not yet moved this activation; it stops right after crossing (dev, 2026-10-08).

dnieprBlocked.effects: Blocked Dniepr hexside prevents movement, attack, advance, retreat, supply trace.

enemyZoc.effects: +1 to exit. Must stop move upon entering. Unit moving from hex in enemy ZOC can't move directly to hex in EZOC. Exceptions: German map-edge move (10.7); Soviet urban infiltration (9.2, method 1).
